exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. not)
cohort: Ethiopian women who gave birth in 2000, 2005, 2011, or 2016, surveyed as part of the Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey (EDHS).
finding: PNC service utilization in Ethiopia increased from 5.6% in 2000 to 18.5% in 2016, with a greater increase observed among urban women.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by caesarean section were more likely to receive PNC services.
